description: Example geometry parameters. Confirm sign and units for your own camera/projector setup.

rig.focus_compensation: Camera Scheimpflug hardware/manual focus; do not software-deblur
rig.keystone_compensation: Use reference phase subtraction, not projector image pre-distortion

units.p: projector pixels or equivalent phase-height period

pcb_reflection_tuning.polarizer: cross-polarized camera/projector filters when solder glare dominates
pcb_reflection_tuning.exposure: keep white image below saturation and black image above noise floor
pcb_reflection_tuning.diffusion: use mild projection diffusion only if it does not blur Gray code edges

notes: Triangulation uses h = sign * (delta_phi * p * d) / (delta_phi * p + 2*pi*l).
delta_phi must be phi_object - phi_reference from the same projector/camera geometry.
The camera-tilt/projector-vertical rig requires a fresh reference and metric calibration. Store rig_layout, camera_tilt_deg, and projector_tilt_deg alongside position-dependent d/l/p maps.
Moreno-Taubin projector calibration metadata is optional but is reported in decode_report.json when present.
The exact sign and denominator convention are system-dependent; use --height-sign to flip if needed.
